# Shortcuts and Helpers

A full list of keyboard shortcuts available in RStudio can be found [here](https://support.posit.co/hc/en-us/articles/200711853-Keyboard-Shortcuts-in-the-RStudio-IDE)

## Keyboard Shortcuts {.unnumbered}

| Description                     | Windows & Linux | Mac              |
|---------------------------------|-----------------|------------------|
| Add Cursor Above Current Cursor | Ctrl+Alt+Up     | Ctrl+Option+Up   |
| Add Cursor Below Current Cursor | Ctrl+Alt+Down   | Ctrl+Option+Down |




Ctrl+Shift+R
